review_candidates.title: Senior Supervisor Application Developer ( .NET AND AI ) Leadership role
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled, multichannel stations. The company supports government and commercial clients in 10 languages across sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. Xceed delivers a wide range of services including inbound and outbound support, back office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk, and social media analysis. The organization is frequently recognized by IAOP, INSIGHTS, Gulf Sustainability Awards, ICXA, IBXA, and Global ESG Awards for excellence in outsourcing, impact sourcing, CSR, sustainability, and diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed maintains robust operational and security standards through multiple certifications, including COPC and ISO credentials for business continuity, quality, environmental management, occupational health and safety, and information security. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Senior Supervisor Application Developer (.NET and AI) leadership role based in Cairo. The role involves leading a team of developers in designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise applications using .NET technologies and AI frameworks. The Senior Supervisor oversees software development life cycles, ensures code quality, manages integrations with databases and external systems, and collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include architectural design, task planning, code reviews, technical mentoring, performance optimization, and ensuring adherence to security and compliance standards. The role also focuses on continuous improvement, introducing new tools and best practices, and supporting scalable, resilient applications aligned with Xceed’s operational and client needs. Qualifications Strong skills in Software Development and Programming, with a focus on .NET technologies (e.g., C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) and AI/ML frameworks. Proficiency working with Databases and Integration, including relational databases, APIs, microservices, and enterprise system connectivity. Experience with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and related front-end technologies to support user interface and user experience requirements. Demonstrated leadership abilities in supervising development teams, setting technical direction, and managing project delivery. Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and secure coding practices in high-availability environments. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to communicate complex concepts clearly. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced certifications in .NET, cloud platforms, or AI are a plus. Experience in BPO, contact center, or enterprise service environments, and familiarity with quality, security, and compliance standards, is advantageous

review_candidates.description: With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility℠. We're looking for a passionate, detail-oriented Senior Full Stack Engineer who is equally comfortable working across the frontend and backend. You'll contribute to both our user-facing React/Angular applications and our Node.js microservices, helping us build, scale, and maintain the systems that power Thimble's platform — including the external-facing APIs our partners rely on. This role goes beyond feature delivery. You'll help shape the technical strategy of the platform, influence architectural direction, and partner directly with product and growth teams to turn business objectives into engineering outcomes — from improving how customers discover and purchase coverage to scaling the systems behind new products and markets. You thrive in event-driven, distributed architectures and have a strong instinct for writing clean, observable, and resilient code. What You'll Do Technical Leadership & Architecture Lead end-to-end system design for complex, high-scale backend platforms — owning the full lifecycle from requirements through implementation and iteration Define architectural principles and engineering best practices that raise the quality bar across the team Make high-impact design decisions involving deliberate trade-offs between scalability, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability Design data models that are well-structured, efficient, and built to evolve alongside the product Full Stack Delivery Design, develop, and maintain full stack features across React/Angular frontends and Node.js backend microservices Build and evolve RESTful and event-driven APIs — both internal services and external-facing APIs consumed by our partners — ensuring they are well-tested, documented, and production-ready Work with MongoDB to design schemas, write efficient queries, and manage data at scale Develop and maintain event-driven workflows using AWS SNS and SQS to manage asynchronous system flows reliably Instrument services with monitoring and observability tooling — setting up metrics, alerts, dashboards, and distributed tracing to ensure system health Investigate and resolve complex bugs and production incidents end-to-end — from the UI down to the service layer Strategy & Growth Partner with product, design, and growth teams on growth initiatives — customer acquisition, activation, and conversion funnel improvements — translating experiment ideas into shippable, measurable features Contribute to experimentation and A/B testing efforts, using data and metrics to validate impact and inform the next iteration Align technical decisions with business strategy — weighing near-term growth opportunities against long-term platform health, and communicating those trade-offs clearly to stakeholders Conduct technical research and propose solutions to new and ambiguous engineering challenges Plan and manage your own work independently, breaking down large features into well-scoped tasks and driving them to delivery Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and contribute to engineering best practices Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers across the stack OUR TECH STACK Frontend: React (Jest), Angular 2+ (Jasmine & Karma), Next.js, Razzle, TypeScript Backend: Node.js microservices (Koa, NestJS) Database: MongoDB Messaging: AWS SNS & SQS (event-driven async flows) Cloud: AWS E2E Testing: Playwright Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Sentry AI Tooling: Claude Code (AI-assisted, agentic development) CI/CD: CircleCI What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional full stack development experience, with a track record of leading system design on complex, high-scale platforms Proven ability to define architectural principles and drive engineering best practices across a team Experience making high-impact design decisions with clear reasoning around trade-offs — scalability vs. cost, performance vs. maintainability, speed vs. reliability Strong data modeling skills — designing schemas and structures that are clean, efficient, and built to scale Strong proficiency in Node.js — building and maintaining production microservices Solid experience with MongoDB — schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines, and query optimization Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures, specifically AWS SNS and SQS or equivalent pub/sub and message queue systems Proficiency in React and/or Angular 2+ for building and maintaining modern frontend applications Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Sentry, or similar) — instrumenting services, creating dashboards, configuring alerts, and using distributed tracing to diagnose issues Experience writing tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E (Jest, Jasmine/Karma, Playwright or similar) General understanding of effective under pressure Ability to plan and own complex features independently from design through to production Strong communication skills and comfort working in a remote, async-friendly
